# InferencePoolConfig resource configuration reference

@include 'alerts/enterprise-alert.mdx'

This topic provides reference information for the `InferencePoolConfig` custom resource. An `InferencePoolConfig` defines a namespace-scoped pool of inference backends that AI workloads in the same namespace can use. Attach the pool to one or more parent resources, such as an [`InferenceGateway`](/consul/docs/reference/k8s/ai/inferencegateway), with the `parentRefs` field.

Refer to [Configure the AI Inference Gateway](/consul/docs/agentic-mesh/inference-gateway/configure) for usage information.

<Warning>

In Consul 2.1, the controller applies only the `processor`, `routing.fallback`, `policy.pii`, and `observability` fields to the gateway's [`inference-gateway` configuration entry](/consul/docs/reference/config-entry/inference-gateway). The resource accepts the `stateStore`, `rateLimit`, `routing.budget`, `routing.cache`, `routing.mirror`, `routing.complianceMap`, `routing.configValidation`, and `policy.auditLevel` fields, but they have no effect. The controller also does not apply `observability.metrics.semconvSchema`, `observability.metrics.customLabels`, or `observability.metrics.prometheus.path`. The processor always serves metrics at `/metrics`.

The `routing.matchRules`, `routing.scoring`, `routing.retry`, and `routing.timeout` fields are not part of the configuration entry.

The `observability` OTLP endpoint fields accept a URL. The controller removes the `http://` or `https://` scheme before it writes the configuration entry.

</Warning>

## Complete configuration

When every field is defined, an `InferencePoolConfig` resource has the following form:

```yaml
apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: InferencePoolConfig
metadata:
  name: <name for this resource>
  namespace: <namespace>
spec:
  enabled: <boolean>
  parentRefs:
    - kind: <string>
      name: <string>
      namespace: <string>
  stateStore:
    service: <string>
    localBindPort: <integer>
  rateLimit:
    enabled: <boolean>
    mode: <soft>
    enforcement: <deny | shadow>
    countMode: <total | input | output>
    degradeMode: <fail_closed | fail_open_unlimited>
    dimensions:
      - <string>
    default:
      requests:
        count: <integer>
        window: <second | minute | hour | day>
      tokens:
        count: <integer>
        window: <second | minute | hour | day>
    global:
      requests:
        count: <integer>
        window: <second | minute | hour | day>
      tokens:
        count: <integer>
        window: <second | minute | hour | day>
    tierLimits:
      - tier: <string>
        maxCompletionTokensCap: <integer>
        requests:
          count: <integer>
          window: <second | minute | hour | day>
        tokens:
          count: <integer>
          window: <second | minute | hour | day>
    tierBindings:
      - tier: <string>
        spiffeIDs:
          - <string>
        namespace: <string>
        partition: <string>
    modelLimits:
      - model: <string>
        requests:
          count: <integer>
          window: <second | minute | hour | day>
        tokens:
          count: <integer>
          window: <second | minute | hour | day>
  routing:
    fallbackChain:
      - <string>
    fallback:
      retryOn:
        - <string>
      maxTiers: <integer>
      perTryTimeout: <string>
    retry:
      retryOn:
        - <string>
      maxAttempts: <integer>
    timeout:
      connect: <string>
      request: <string>
    scoring:
      scorers:
        - <string>
      weightedSplit:
        - cluster: <string>
          weight: <integer>
    matchRules:
      - when:
          path: <string>
          identity:
            service: <string>
            namespace: <string>
            partition: <string>
          bodyHas:
            - <string>
        candidates:
          - <string>
        fallbackChain:
          - <string>
        requireCapabilities:
          - <string>
    complianceMap: <map>
    budget: <map>
    cache: <map>
    mirror: <map>
    configValidation: <string>
  policy:
    auditLevel: <none | request | full>
    pii:
      scope: <request | response | both>
      defaultAction: <placeholder | mask | block | False>
      streamHoldbackBytes: <integer>
      mask:
        char: <string>
        keepLast: <integer>
      detectors:
        - name: <string>
          regex: <string>
          action: <placeholder | mask | block | False>
  processor:
    failureMode: <closed | open>
    bodyModelRouting: <boolean>
  observability:
    metrics:
      enabled: <boolean>
      semconvSchema: <string>
      customLabels:
        - <string>
      prometheus:
        port: <integer>
        path: <string>
      otlp:
        endpoint: <string>
        insecure: <boolean>
    tracing:
      enabled: <boolean>
      sampleRatio: <number>
      otlp:
        endpoint: <string>
        insecure: <boolean>
```

## Specification

This section describes the fields you can configure in the `InferencePoolConfig` resource.

### `apiVersion`

Specifies the API version of the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String value that must be set to `consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1`.

### `kind`

Specifies the type of resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String value that must be set to `InferencePoolConfig`.

### `metadata`

Map that contains the name and namespace for the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Map

### `metadata.name`

Specifies the name of the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `metadata.namespace`

Specifies the Kubernetes namespace for the resource.

#### Values

- Default: The namespace of the current Kubernetes context.
- Data type: String

### `spec`

InferencePoolConfigSpec specifies the desired state of the InferencePoolConfig.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Map

### `spec.enabled`

Enabled controls whether this pool is active. When `false`, the controller marks the pool as standing by and Consul does not advertise the backends.

#### Values

- Default: `false`
- This field is required.
- Data type: Boolean

### `spec.parentRefs`

ParentRefs attaches this pool to one or more InferenceGateway resources. Each entry must resolve to an InferenceGateway object (to be introduced as a separate CRD and operator). The InferenceGateway operator discovers all InferencePoolConfigs that reference it and composes their rateLimit and routing rules into the gateway's xDS configuration. The controller for this resource validates that every referenced parent exists before marking the pool Ready.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: List

### `spec.parentRefs.kind`

Kind is the Kind of the parent resource. Expected value once the gateway CRD is available: "InferenceGateway".

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `spec.parentRefs.name`

Name is the name of the parent InferenceGateway resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `spec.parentRefs.namespace`

Namespace is the namespace of the parent InferenceGateway. When omitted defaults to "default". Cross-namespace references require both resources to share the same Consul admin partition.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.stateStore`

StateStore locates the shared rate-limit counter as a Consul mesh service. Required when rateLimit.enabled=true — Consul rejects the config entry with HTTP 500 if rateLimit is enabled but no StateStore is provided.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.stateStore.service`

Service is the Consul mesh service name of the rate-limit counter store (e.g. "valkey", "redis"). Must be registered in the Consul catalog and reachable through service-mesh mTLS.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `spec.stateStore.localBindPort`

LocalBindPort is the loopback port the gateway's Envoy binds and the rate-limit processor dials to reach the counter store (range 1-65535).

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Integer
- Minimum: `1`
- Maximum: `65535`

### `spec.rateLimit`

RateLimit defines optional token- and request-rate-limiting rules for this pool. When omitted, no rate limiting is applied.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.rateLimit.enabled`

Enabled controls whether rate limiting is active for this pool.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Boolean

### `spec.rateLimit.mode`

Mode selects the rate-limit algorithm. soft — V1; per-instance counters with best-effort global sync. Default. Note: "strict" (V2) is not yet implemented and is rejected by Consul with HTTP 500. Only "soft" is accepted.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `soft`

### `spec.rateLimit.enforcement`

Enforcement sets the enforcement mode for rate-limit violations. deny — requests over limit are rejected (HTTP 429). Default. shadow — limits tracked but never enforced (dry-run).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `deny`
  - `shadow`

### `spec.rateLimit.countMode`

CountMode determines what is counted against limits. total — count every request regardless of token direction. Default. input — count only prompt/input tokens. output — count only completion/output tokens.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `total`
  - `input`
  - `output`

### `spec.rateLimit.degradeMode`

DegradeMode controls degradation when the rate-limit StateStore is unavailable. fail_closed — reject all requests (HTTP 503). Default. fail_open_unlimited — admit all requests and emit audit log.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `fail_closed`
  - `fail_open_unlimited`

### `spec.rateLimit.dimensions`

Dimensions lists request attributes used to partition rate-limit counters (e.g. ["identity", "model"]).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.rateLimit.default`

Default is the fallback limit pair applied to requests that do not match a more specific tier or model limit.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.rateLimit.default.requests`

Requests defines the request-count rate limit.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.rateLimit.default.requests.count`

Count is the maximum allowed number of requests or tokens in the window.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Integer

### `spec.rateLimit.default.requests.window`

Time unit for the counter window (second, minute, hour, or day).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `second`
  - `minute`
  - `hour`
  - `day`

### `spec.rateLimit.default.tokens`

Tokens defines the token-count rate limit.

#### Values

- Data type: Map

  - `hour`
  - `day`

### `spec.routing`

Routing defines optional traffic-routing, failover, retry, and caching rules for this pool. When omitted, Consul applies its built-in defaults.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.fallbackChain`

FallbackChain lists backend names in priority order for cross-provider failover. Deprecated; retained for backward compatibility.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.fallback`

Fallback tunes cross-provider failover behaviour for capability pools.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.fallback.retryOn`

RetryOn is the list of conditions that trigger a failover attempt to the next provider (e.g. ["5xx", "reset"]).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.fallback.maxTiers`

MaxTiers is the maximum number of provider-level failover hops before the request is failed.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Integer

### `spec.routing.fallback.perTryTimeout`

PerTryTimeout is the timeout per failover attempt as a Go duration string (e.g. "30s").

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.routing.retry`

Retry configures automatic retry behaviour for upstream requests.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.retry.retryOn`

RetryOn is the list of conditions that trigger a retry attempt (e.g. ["5xx", "reset", "connect-failure"]).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.retry.maxAttempts`

MaxAttempts is the maximum number of retry attempts per request.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Integer

### `spec.routing.timeout`

Timeout configures connection and request timeouts for pool traffic.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.timeout.connect`

Connect is the timeout for establishing a connection to the upstream as a Go duration string (e.g. "5s").

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.routing.timeout.request`

Request is the end-to-end request/response cycle timeout as a Go duration string (e.g. "120s").

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.routing.scoring`

Scoring tunes the backend-selection scoring model used by Consul when choosing between candidates.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.scoring.scorers`

Scorers is the ordered list of scoring strategies to apply (e.g. ["latency-aware", "round-robin"]).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.scoring.weightedSplit`

WeightedSplit defines an explicit weighted split across backend clusters.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.scoring.weightedSplit.cluster`

Cluster is the Consul upstream service name for this target.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `spec.routing.scoring.weightedSplit.weight`

Weight is the relative traffic weight assigned to this cluster.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Integer

### `spec.routing.matchRules`

MatchRules is an ordered list of request-matching rules. The first matching rule wins.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.matchRules.when`

When defines the predicate for this rule.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.matchRules.when.path`

Path matches requests whose URL path has this prefix or exact value.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.routing.matchRules.when.identity`

Identity matches requests based on the caller's SPIFFE identity.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.matchRules.when.identity.service`

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.routing.matchRules.when.identity.namespace`

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.routing.matchRules.when.identity.partition`

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.routing.matchRules.when.bodyHas`

BodyHas is a list of JSON pointer expressions that must be present in the request body.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.matchRules.candidates`

Candidates explicitly lists backend names eligible for matching requests.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.matchRules.fallbackChain`

FallbackChain lists backend names to try when every candidate is unavailable.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.matchRules.requireCapabilities`

RequireCapabilities filters candidates to only those advertising all listed capability labels.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.routing.complianceMap`

ComplianceMap maps a compliance label to its configuration.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.budget`

Budget is an open-ended JSON object for cost/token-budget settings passed to Consul without further validation.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.cache`

Cache is an open-ended JSON object for semantic-cache settings passed to Consul without further validation.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.mirror`

Mirror is an open-ended JSON object for traffic-mirroring settings passed to Consul without further validation.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.routing.configValidation`

ConfigValidation sets the strictness of config validation at admission time (e.g. "strict", "warn", "off").

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.policy`

Policy holds cross-cutting request/response policy (PII detection, redaction, and audit) that the co-located policy processor enforces. Consul carries it verbatim to the processor. When omitted, no policy processing is applied.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.policy.auditLevel`

AuditLevel sets the verbosity of the audit log emitted by the processor. Allowed values: none, request, full.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `none`
  - `request`
  - `full`

### `spec.policy.pii`

PII configures per-detector PII detection and redaction for requests and responses passing through the policy processor.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.policy.pii.scope`

Scope controls which parts of the conversation are scanned. Allowed values: request, response, both.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `request`
  - `response`
  - `both`

### `spec.policy.pii.defaultAction`

DefaultAction is the fallback action applied when a detector fires and no per-detector action is set. Allowed values: placeholder, mask, block, off.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `placeholder`
  - `mask`
  - `block`
  - `False`

### `spec.policy.pii.streamHoldbackBytes`

StreamHoldbackBytes is the number of bytes buffered from a streaming response before PII scanning begins.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Integer

### `spec.policy.pii.mask`

Mask parameterizes the "mask" redaction action.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.policy.pii.mask.char`

Char is the character used to replace each masked rune (default "*").

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.policy.pii.mask.keepLast`

KeepLast is the number of characters at the end of a detected span that are left unmasked.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Integer

### `spec.policy.pii.detectors`

Detectors is the ordered list of PII detection rules. Each entry names a built-in detector or provides a custom Regex, with an optional per-rule Action that overrides DefaultAction.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.policy.pii.detectors.name`

Name identifies the detector. Built-ins (underscore form): credit_card, api_key, ssn, email. For a custom detector, set a non-empty regex — name then acts as a label for logs.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.policy.pii.detectors.regex`

Regex is a RE2 pattern. Required when name is not one of the four built-ins (credit_card, api_key, ssn, email); the Consul API rejects a custom detector without a regex. Optional for built-ins; when set it replaces the built-in pattern (the credit_card Luhn check is then skipped).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.policy.pii.detectors.action`

Action overrides the policy defaultAction for this specific detector. Allowed values: placeholder, mask, block, off.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `placeholder`
  - `mask`
  - `block`
  - `False`

### `spec.processor`

Processor configures the ext_proc binding between Envoy and the co-located consul-inference-gateway process. The socket path is host-local, per-instance state and is not part of the cluster-wide config entry; consul-dataplane derives it per proxy instance.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.processor.failureMode`

FailureMode controls Envoy's behaviour when the ext_proc server is unreachable. closed — reject the request (HTTP 500), safe for production. open — pass the request through without ext_proc processing.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String value set to one of the following:
  - `closed`
  - `open`

### `spec.processor.bodyModelRouting`

BodyModelRouting routes on the request body's model field instead of a caller-supplied capability header. Consul renders the matching per-model route when true.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Boolean

### `spec.observability`

Observability configures the processor's telemetry pillars (metrics and tracing). Each pillar is independent; a degraded sink degrades only that pillar and never changes a request's outcome.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.observability.metrics`

Metrics configures OTel metrics export. Metrics are enabled by default; set enabled=false to disable.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.observability.metrics.enabled`

Enabled controls whether the processor exports metrics at all. Default: true.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Boolean

### `spec.observability.metrics.semconvSchema`

SemconvSchema pins the OTel semantic-convention schema version on every exported metric resource. The processor implements exactly "1.37.0"; any other value is rejected by Consul. Omit to use the processor default.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.observability.metrics.customLabels`

CustomLabels is a list of bare label key names (identifiers) promoted onto every exported metric. Each entry must match ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$ (e.g. ["env", "team"]). Maximum 8 entries. Do not use key=value pairs.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: List

### `spec.observability.metrics.prometheus`

Prometheus configures the Prometheus pull-based scrape endpoint.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.observability.metrics.prometheus.port`

Port is the TCP port the scrape endpoint listens on. Default: 9090.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Integer

### `spec.observability.metrics.prometheus.path`

Path is the HTTP path that serves metrics. Default: "/metrics".

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.observability.metrics.otlp`

OTLP configures a push-based OTLP metrics exporter.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.observability.metrics.otlp.endpoint`

Endpoint is the OTLP collector URL (e.g. "http://otel-collector:4318").

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.observability.metrics.otlp.insecure`

Insecure disables TLS verification when true. Use only in non-production environments.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Boolean

### `spec.observability.tracing`

Tracing configures OTel distributed tracing. Off by default.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.observability.tracing.enabled`

Enabled controls whether the processor emits spans. Default: false.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Boolean

### `spec.observability.tracing.sampleRatio`

SampleRatio is the fraction of requests to trace (0.0–1.0). 0.0 = never, 1.0 = always. Default: 0.01 (1%).

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Number
- Minimum: `0`
- Maximum: `1`

### `spec.observability.tracing.otlp`

OTLP configures the OTLP trace exporter endpoint.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.observability.tracing.otlp.endpoint`

Endpoint is the OTLP collector URL (e.g. "http://otel-collector:4318").

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: String

### `spec.observability.tracing.otlp.insecure`

Insecure disables TLS verification when true. Use only in non-production environments.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Boolean
